description: Node structure (LexicalStructure.ts) and @lexical/extension's NodeStructureExtension: the declarations of the packages' nodes and of test classes read along the config chain (inline, children, mergeAdjacent, derived, declaredBy), and the normalization: blocks lifted out of holders of inline content (paragraphs, quotes, links, marks, list items) with the holder split around them, paragraphs joined as lines, inline content wrapped in a container's paragraph, empty inline elements removed, equal adjacent links, lists and test elements merged (by schema field and NodeState), ListNode's merge and split hooks and ListItemNode's lift hook, the selection kept among its content (text outside the BMP included), $isBlockContainer and $insertList in a declared container, INTERNAL_$normalizeNodeStructure, registerNodeStructure's counted registrations, the extension's disabled signal and disposal, and BlockIdExtension's peer dependency on it.

cases.name: declarations
off by default: the declarations change nothing
a block in a paragraph is lifted out, the paragraph split
a block put in a paragraph later is lifted the same way
paragraphs in a quote become lines; an empty one keeps its line
a heading in a quote is lifted out and keeps its type
a heading in a link holds the link; a block in a mark keeps the mark
equal adjacent links merge; different ones and autolinks do not
links made adjacent by a change merge
test elements merge by field and NodeState; a subclass that inherits it does not
an empty inline element is removed; an OverflowNode stays in its paragraph
inline content in a box is wrapped in a paragraph; a sub-box inherits the rule
$insertList in a declared container converts the block inside it
adjacent lists of one type merge whatever their start; nested lists join at the seam
a block decorator splits an ordered list; numbering continues
paragraphs in a list item become lines; a nested list beside content is lifted
INTERNAL_$normalizeNodeStructure normalizes a subtree without the extension
registerNodeStructure: counted registrations
disabled: the declarations are only read; enabling normalizes the document
BlockIdExtension registers after NodeStructureExtension, its peer
